commands: title=$(jq -r .title "var/incidents/$(ls var/incidents | sort | tail -1)"); case "$title" in *eplica*|*lag*) check=replica-lag ;; *ueue*) check=queue-depth ;; *) check=api-errors ;; esac; limit=$(awk -v c="$check" '$1 == c {print $2}' config/health.conf); value=$(python3 -c "print(round($limit * 1.6, 1))"); printf '{"value": %s, "updated": "%s"}\n' "$value" "$(date '+%F %H:%M')" > "var/health/$check.json"; echo "$check"; cat "var/health/$check.json"
tools/healthcheck || echo "failing again, as seen on the system"
